propositions: Live Cloud rehearsal against two shared projects exposed parse-ERRORs on non-existent project keys that the fake transport masked, and two projects cannot model all required scenarios (one/two/zero repos, empty, unknown).

Ephemeral Jira DC instance supports creating and destroying throwaway projects per run with admin rights, enabling reproducible CI-verified rehearsals in jira-dc-harness job instead of manual Cloud validation.

Per-project JQL queries and issue creation across multiple projects must not contaminate unintended projects, verified by dry-run gating (bridge preview) before each sync and asserting mutations target only the intended project.
Configured-but-empty projects and unknown-to-Jira keys must be handled safely: empty projects return empty results, unknown keys cause fail-closed behavior with no mutations applied.
Test scenarios validate three repo configurations, explicit empty projects, cross-project target errors, and project isolation with cleanup on every exit path including mid-run failures.
Live DC run validation confirms 10 scenarios passing green with correct mutation application, project isolation, and complete teardown of ephemeral scratch projects.
